assets: A small tribal mud-and-timber cottage with a straw thatch roof. Roof is neutral pale straw with straw gold accents, EARTHY but luminous. Clean honey-beige mud walls matching roof material family, dark natural timberposts, a centered wooden door, a small square window left and an unlit iron sconce on right.

A long narrow tribal chieftain's hall, early City Keep. Ground footprint THREE tiles wide and SEVEN tiles deep, meaning very long from top tobottom. Long pitched deep blue slate shingled roof with a small restrained royal blue cloth banner near back ridge. Facade is pale limestone and dark timber, centered broad oak double door with iron hardware, two narrow glowing-free windows. Proud grand but modest tribal architecture, no tall castle towers.

A small village bakery workshop with sage green glazed tile roof and honey beige mud/timber walls. Center timber door, breadstall shelf on left with two goldenloaves, rounded pale stone ovenfront on right, no fire/glow. Very short chimney can be part of roof silhouette. Luminous natural materials matching Zelda-like village.
sharedPrompt: Single complete 2D game building sprite. Charming polished Zelda-like adventure village environments, slightly chunky deliberate pixel art, 32 source pixels per logical tile, broad handcrafted forms and 2-4 pixel highlight clusters, clean shaded planes, no granular noise or photoreal straw. Shiny material highlights, rich dimensional shadows, balanced natural hues without orange or blue/cold wash. Daylight upperleft, sparse creamy highlight strips with rich shaded underside. Fixed elevated topdown, north roof at top and south front facade at bottom, axis-aligned rectangular footprint, no isometric or three-quarter view. Transparent background, no surrounding ground, cast shadow, entities, labels or text. Whole building in frame, small margins. Target112x128 cottage/bakery,112x256long3x7keep. Roof occupies most height, frontwall horizontal strip atbottom.
